{{Top|leg}}
'''Conqueror of Verdanth''' was a title that was held by a number of different [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verdanth]] was frequently fought over by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and as a result, the title was assumed by a new Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] every few [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
